decisions.statement: A user id the caller states is taken as given.
The session is asked only where the caller states no user id.
An answer with an error is refused.
An answer with no user is refused.
A refusal names the work that wanted a user.
A refusal has the error the session named.
A refusal that the session explained no further says the user was absent.
The session is asked for the user id and for nothing else.
Nothing here names the handler that asked.

definition: which user the watcher writes under, taken from the caller or from the session
